findings.summary: cache_info validates --interval against the spot market even when --market futures is given, so `cache-info --market futures --interval 6h` is accepted and silently lists nothing instead of being refused like everywhere else; harmless today, and no spec line covers it.
UNKNOWN_WEIGHT_WAIT keeps the Binance 'weight' name after WeightPacer became RateLimitPacer and the weight header was removed; a naming leftover only.
